details.description: Empty ground, flat dark desaturated teal-black. No object ink. Confirms the reference is an isolated single-object plate with no scene content.

Cap in full. CORRECTION on the first-pass analysis: the top edge carries a generous round, not a slight chamfer, roughly a tenth of the cap radius. There are TWO fine bright circumferential grooves near the lower edge, not one, set close together, with a short straight band below them. Cap height reads about three quarters of cap diameter. Surface is satin: a broad low-intensity highlight lobe across the upper third, no point specular.
Empty ground with a faint falloff toward the frame edge. No object ink.

Proximal-left body edge and shoulder. The vertical corner fillet radius is larger than first estimated, roughly an eighth of the body depth. The inner wall boundary is visible as a second vertical line inboard of the outer edge, which is the read used for the glass thickness estimate. A bright vertical lighting highlight runs the full edge and is excluded from albedo.

Body centre through the juice. Amber deepens markedly through the thick centre against the thin edges, which is depth absorption rather than a flat tint. The rear inner wall is visible through the front wall. No caustic pattern is present to reproduce.
Lateral-right body face and its fillet, carrying the rim light. The lateral face is visibly narrower than the front face, confirming body depth at roughly four tenths of body width.
Lower proximal corner and contact shadow. The base meets the ground on a pronounced horizontal round, not a sharp edge.

Base slab and label in full. The solid unfilled glass foot is unmistakable: a strong horizontal internal boundary separates it from the juice above, and it occupies roughly a sixth of the body height. The bottom outer edge is a large round. The label is a plain light rectangle, flush on the front face, with no lettering and a visible straight edge.

Ground plane and contact shadow only. The shadow is soft and short, consistent with one large key from upper left; it grounds the object and must be reproduced as a contact shadow rather than baked into the body.

corrections: Cap top edge: generous round, not a slight chamfer (zone-r0c1).
Cap grooves: two fine circumferential grooves, not one (zone-r0c1).
Collar brushing: fine AXIAL striations, not circumferential lathe brushing (zone-r0c1). The first-pass analysis had this wrong; the spec follows the crop.
Corner fillet radius and base bottom round are both larger than the first-pass estimate (zone-r1c0, zone-r2c0, zone-r2c1).
